remaining_cautions.finding: 33 linked database rows remain source_conflict because database aggregate entries or values cannot be row-verified beyond the local packet.
Supplement Table S2 values were recovered by layout text, but the table body does not print a unit; raw_unit records preserve that missingness.
Figure S2 supports D2 MIC distribution ranges for 100 isolates but no exact per-isolate numeric matrix was locally recoverable.
Mechanism conclusions are limited to the time-kill, PMF fluorescence, and macromolecule-biosynthesis assays; receptor-level speculation remains unverified.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Supplement Table S2 prints MIC values but no unit in the table body; main-text/database context was not used to overwrite the raw table unit.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Table S2 values are retained with raw_unit=unit_not_reported_in_supplement_table and are not normalized or converted.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local material provides a range/distribution figure for 50 S. pseudintermedius and 50 P. aeruginosa isolates but no per-isolate numeric matrix.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Only source-supported MIC ranges are retained as summary records; no individual 100-isolate values were fabricated.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: CAMP/dbAMP aggregate entries in linked_experiment_records contain database sequence IDs but the packet lacks primary sequence/name rows for those database identifiers.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Those database rows are preserved as source_conflict or database_only_no_primary_source rather than converted to source_verified.
